_about: Public-domain Robert Jamieson (1802-1880), minister of St Paul's, Glasgow, for the Word Hoard: The Inspiration of the Holy Scriptures, the Baird Lecture (1873), The Pentateuch and the Book of Joshua with commentary (1860), The Manners and Trials of the Primitive Christians (second edition, 1841) and the volume he wrote for the Jamieson-Fausset-Brown Commentary (Genesis to Deuteronomy, 1871), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 36 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
